notes: Gestures: on a Magic Mouse swipe one finger to go back or forward a page, swipe two fingers to switch apps, and double-tap with two fingers for Launchpad
On a trackpad: three-finger swipes switch apps, three fingers up opens Launchpad and down shows the desktop, two-finger swipes go back and forward
Adds support for the newest USB-C Magic Mouse (scrolling and gestures)
